notes: StrataToken (src/StrataToken.sol) is the StrataIMD (STRATA) token: a plain, fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 STRATA (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the factory, which pays it out as the launch directs: the swarm's share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 80% to the single-sided Uniswap v4 pool paired with IMD, and the rest to economics.remainderTo. Every transfer moves exactly the amount requested, with no fee, tax, reflection or burn, so no launch address needs exempting and none is configured. There is no owner, minter, pause, blocklist, freeze, seize, burnFrom or upgrade path, and no receive or fallback: the supply can never grow and nobody but a holder can move a holder's balance. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT, and nothing is linked. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
